title: Your first itch.io page
key_points: A Project page on itch.io is how you share what you've created with the world.
All you need to create a page for your game, comic, soundtrack, assets, etc. is a free itch.io account.
To get started, hit the 'Create new game' button.
limitations: Since itch.io started as a game marketplace, most of the vocabulary is game-centric – as the platform evolves towards other types of content, we'll keep adjusting that.
asserts: A Project page on itch.io is how you share what you've created with the world.
scope: The guide explains how to create a project page on the itch.io platform for games, comics, soundtracks, assets and other types of content using an account.
